ns2:section.sectionText: This section is reserved for UIUC undergraduate students (others interested in this course may enroll in ENG 451 SW2). ENG 451 SW1 is an online course worth two hours of credit and counts toward the Other Social Sciences/Humanities requirement for engineering students. Academic Outreach assessments of $503 per credit hour apply. This course is restricted to students who have a career-related internship or co-op during the Summer 2010 term. If you do not meet this requirement you will be disqualified from the course. Please contact Sarah Zehr at szehr@illinois.edu or 217-333-1960 with questions about this policy.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign. Not intended for NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
